reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound, correctly identifying the well-known protective nature of Al2O3 and SiO2 versus non-protective Mn-oxides, but it oversimplifies by ignoring the critical role of Cr in the base alloy and the complex thermodynamics of selective oxidation in multi-principal element alloys.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and feasible, with a well-defined falsification criterion, though the adhesion test (scratch test) may be difficult to interpret on a thin, high-temperature oxide scale and the baseline definition is slightly ambiguous.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is useful as a starting point for isolating the effect of the X element, but its value is limited because it does not address the core mechanistic question of why some oxides crack or spall, merely restating a known compositional trend.
